method.review: All ten ASR files were read in chronological order. Claims below are short paraphrases with time windows, not transcript redistribution.
method.evidence_boundary: ASR proves what the presenter said, not that every visible output, vendor capability or quality judgment is correct. Visual-result claims remain speaker-reported until linked to frame evidence; current model capabilities require official documentation.
